games_fork_provenance_check.name: games_fork_provenance_check
games_fork_provenance_check.value: ("games"."forked_from_game_id" IS NULL AND "games"."forked_from_release_id" IS NULL) OR ("games"."forked_from_game_id" IS NOT NULL AND "games"."forked_from_release_id" IS NOT NULL)

invitations_target_check.name: invitations_target_check
invitations_target_check.value: ("invitations"."kind" = 'member' AND "invitations"."capability" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."game_id" IS NULL AND "invitations"."room_id" IS NULL) OR ("invitations"."kind" = 'play' AND "invitations"."capability" IS NULL AND "invitations"."game_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."room_id" IS NULL) OR ("invitations"."kind" = 'room' AND "invitations"."capability" IS NULL AND "invitations"."game_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."room_id" IS NOT NULL)

branches_fork_point_check.name: branches_fork_point_check
branches_fork_point_check.value: ("branches"."fork_parent_branch_id" IS NULL AND "branches"."fork_parent_rev" IS NULL AND "branches"."fork_git_sha" IS NULL) OR ("branches"."fork_parent_branch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "branches"."fork_parent_rev" >= 0)

scope_sessions_agreed_payload.name: scope_sessions_agreed_payload
scope_sessions_agreed_payload.value: ("scope_sessions"."revision" = 0 AND "scope_sessions"."scope" IS NULL AND "scope_sessions"."scope_hash" IS NULL) OR ("scope_sessions"."revision" > 0 AND "scope_sessions"."scope" IS NOT NULL AND "scope_sessions"."scope_hash" IS NOT NULL)
